verdict.rationale: A probe found an official MCP server published by BugSnag's parent SmartBear (SmartBear/smartbear-mcp), and BugSnag's own changelog announces OAuth 2.0 browser-login support for its self-hosted MCP server, so agents can connect to BugSnag data. missing for 10: documentation of which BugSnag tools and operations the MCP server exposes, setup and configuration details for agent clients, any hosted (non-self-hosted) endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
